method: Each room independently generated once with built-in imagegen; original pixels retained

prompts.name: cockpit
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: native high-resolution 3:2 landscape room background for an explorable personal-blog world, one self-contained room only.
Input images: Image 1 (mecha-interiors.png) is a reference atlas containing three stacked rooms; use only the specified room as composition reference. Image 2 (mecha-isometric.png) is supporting material/palette style reference. These are references, not output canvases. Do not return a stacked atlas or multiple views.
Primary request: Rebuild the specified interior as a SINGLE landscape illustration, 1536 x 1024 native output, or largest supported native 3:2 landscape. This must be newly resolved fine detail, not an enlargement of the source pixels.
Camera: neutral elevated orthographic 2.5D projection matching the atlas, rear wall across upper third, visible floor plane, left/right walls symmetrical; no dramatic wide-angle perspective, no diagonal diamond view.
Art direction: sophisticated illustrated game environment, finely resolved individually shaped bolts, seams, panel edges and tiny objects; crisp natural brushed/oxidized metal and paper texture; careful quiet linework with painterly shading, NOT photorealistic, NOT coarse pixel art, NOT blurry, NOT stippled noise, NOT ornate black-and-gold fantasy decoration. The reference is too murky: reveal the warm old ivory/gray metal with soft broad readable ambient fill, restrained amber wall lamps, small oxidized teal highlights, midnight-blue recesses. Maintain the understated aged mechanical world.
Composition: structural room walls/frame extend to ALL four image edges; no room floating against black empty canvas. Retain the entire usable floor, the whole bottom-center entry doorway and its threshold. Entry at x=50%, y=91% opens onto a wide unobstructed central walking floor. Human furniture scale: an imagined standing adult would occupy about 12% of image height; ordinary desk physical height about 8% of image height. No person is shown. Restrict furniture to sensible perimeter areas unless specifically requested. Clear circulation, no floor clutter or blocked routes. Only subtle small easter egg object as specified.
Constraints: exactly one image; no title, written words, letters, labels, caption, watermark, UI overlay, person, or character. In-world screens may have restrained unlabeled diagrams. No split panels, collage, atlas, border margin.
Room: 航迹室, use the TOP room of Image 1 as the visual/layout reference.
Back center: a modest navigational map console across x=38–62%, y=19–35%, with a small functional pilot chair centered at x=50%, y=37%. The chair is human scale, never a giant throne. An unlabeled muted amber route chart sits on the rear wall.
Left wall: orderly archive cabinets, a few restrained honor plaques and record drawers at x=13–31%, y=22–48%. Place a SMALL vintage radio on the left-side console, near x=22%, y=45%, with visible quiet dial and speaker grille, a subtle discoverable detail.
Right wall: a personal-record writing desk at x=71–85%, y=30–49%, with small papers, a desk lamp, drawers and stool; grounded practical furniture.
Keep the broad center and lower floor clear from the bottom-center doorway through to the pilot chair. Gray/old-ivory paneling dominates over amber; restrained teal patina, readable low-contrast shadows. Preserve the room's calm archive/cockpit identity.

vaultPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one native high-resolution walkable secret-room background for a personal-blog mechanical world.
Primary request: generate exactly ONE independent 3:2 landscape image at native 1536 x 1024, of a small quiet PRIVATE ARCHIVE VAULT inside an ancient mech. This is a new room, not a modification of the reference canvas, and not an atlas.
Input images: Image 1 cockpit.png and Image 2 library.png are supporting visual references for camera, craftsmanship, palette, structural room framing and actual furniture scale. Preserve that world and rendering language, while making this private archive room more intimate, simpler and quieter.
Camera/composition: fixed neutral elevated orthographic 2.5D oblique overhead projection like the reference rooms; rear wall horizontal across the upper image, left/right side walls, south entry at bottom center. NOT diagonal diamond isometric, NOT wide-angle, NOT eye-level. Entire usable floor, complete south doorway, threshold and a short approach landing remain visible. Room architecture fills the full frame and reaches all image edges with structural armor and wall panels, not a floating miniature against black canvas.
Layout: a compact chamber with a broad EMPTY center and clear circulation from the south door to every object. The back wall contains a modest bank of archive drawers and closed files at x=35–66%, y=18–34%, some small aged paper bundles and unlabeled old volumes. Against the LEFT wall, one small practical OLD WOOD desk at x=15–30%, y=35–49%, an old open notebook and a warm small desk lamp; clear leg space and modest small stool pushed neatly under the desk. Against the RIGHT wall, a closed lockable storage cabinet at x=73–86%, y=24–47%, with a single understated mechanical combination-lock wheel and metal handle, no visible numbers or letters. The rest of the center and lower room is bare walkable metal floor, free of cables and clutter. No center altar, center table, giant furniture, piles of props or obstacles blocking the door.
Scale: practical human furniture scale. An imagined adult would be 12% of image height, ordinary desk physical height around 8%; show no adult or person. Small room made through fewer furnishings and a compact footprint, not giant furnishings. Crisp legible silhouettes and coherent grounded shadows for obstacle boundaries. Door opening centered at x=50%, y=89–96%; clear entry floor near x=50%, y=77%. Keep the left notebook and right lock obvious enough to serve as small interaction targets, but do not draw UI.
Style/materials: highly resolved illustrated game environment, fine individual bolts, panel seams, drawer handles and paper edges. Gray and old-ivory weathered armor, modest worn wood, amber practical lamps, small oxidized teal accent panels, midnight blue structural recesses. Same sophisticated hand-crafted 2.5D detail as references. Crisp natural surfaces and restrained painterly shading; no blurred enlarged pixels, no coarse pixel grid, no photorealism, no random stippling, no noisy gold filigree.
Lighting: intimate calm warm ambient illumination with soft readable floor shadows. Light enough to navigate, not murky; amber glow restrained, cool aged teal visible. Quiet private archive mood.
Constraints: one room and one image only; no written words, text, titles, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, UI overlay, passwords drawn in the image, people, animals or characters. No collage, variants, borders or black empty margins.
